## 0938f7c346fb

**Reproduced test-infrastructure defect on source SHA-256 `0cc830e86e26bf1830cda96f84b6f506930f35e2989a4f1780889057fd557cb2`.** The selected task tests fail portable-runtime preflight before pytest. Line 21 derives canonical data from `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`, producing the nonexistent path `/tmp/.../generators/0938f7c346fb/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`.

The concrete fix is to replace the fixed-depth path with `reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)` plus `canonical_pairs` or `canonical_path`. This finding does not assert a semantic generator defect; the tests never execute in the staged layout, so they currently cannot provide the advertised regression coverage there.

Evidence: `checks/audit/0938f7c346fb-task-tests/result.json` (exit 2, `test_status=preflight_failed`, exact diagnostic) and `checks/audit/0938f7c346fb/portable-test-failure.json`. No source was modified.
